name: Thunderhawk Wings
summary: Across the central and southern Barrens, hunters claim Thunderhawk Wings from the wind serpents that soar overhead. At Camp Taurajo, Jorn Skyseer receives them as proof of a hunter’s strength, cunning, and endurance.

sections.title: Trophy of the Hunt
sections.body: Hunters stationed at Camp Taurajo prize a pair of intact Thunderhawk Wings. Wind serpents, whom local hunters call thunderhawks, are fierce winged reptiles that strike swiftly from above. Tracking them across the open plains and claiming their wings in combat tests a hunter’s skill. For an initiate, bringing back the wings proves readiness to follow the lifelong path of an accomplished hunter.

faq.answer: Thunderhawk Wings come from thunderhawks gliding above the ridges and plains of the central and southern Barrens, especially around Camp Taurajo.
Jorn Skyseer, a seasoned tauren hunter stationed at Camp Taurajo, asks for the wings as proof that an initiate has mastered the savanna’s hunting rites.

faq.q: What does claiming the wings signify?
faq.answer: Bringing the wings to Jorn Skyseer completes a challenging rite of passage. It shows the hunter has the strength, courage, and patience to face fierce aerial predators.

angles.text: As a hunter, claiming a soaring thunderhawk’s wings marks a rite of passage. It tests your tracking, patience, and marksmanship against swift aerial beasts.
As a tauren, you honor the savanna’s spirit by harvesting these wings and showing respect for the Earthmother’s fierce creatures.
